lens4_audits.public_summary: Friston (2010) and Laukkonen & Slagter (2021) establish variational free-energy precision weighting and meditative predictive-processing precursors while lacking the joined three-condition Beautiful Loop synthesis. All 9 joined families appear simultaneously in OSF v1 (2024-09-08, Laukkonen & Chandaria; Karl Friston joins at OSF v2 2025-03-11) and persist through OSF v3 (2025-06-16) and the Neuroscience & Biobehavior
